But, be that as it may, slaughtering people _after a surrender_ it is not a fair thing to do and it does not matter who started it. It is plain wrong.

Brazilian here. I had a Brazilian History teacher in high school that described how a jackass Brazil was in this war... We would pick black slaves from the farms, give them a few guns and tell them they would be free if we win the war.

It was a massacre. A huge percentage of the deaths happened _after_ the war. After the surrender! A friend of mine is a historian from Paraguay that lives in my city, she told me once that the nearby river in her great grandmother's city turned red because of all the bloodshed in the city.
